Jd Com (JD) Shareholder Scopia Capital Management LP Cut Its Holding by $12.36 Million; Budros Ruhlin & Roe Lifted Its Holding in Apple Computer (AAPL) as Stock Rose
June 2, 2018 - By Linda Rogers
Budros Ruhlin & Roe Inc increased its stake in Apple Computer Inc (AAPL) by 5.72% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Budros Ruhlin & Roe Inc bought 2,496 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 46,163 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $7.75M, up from 43,667 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Budros Ruhlin & Roe Inc who had been investing in Apple Computer Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $935.06B market cap company. The stock increased 1.80% or $3.37 $190.24. About 21.25M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since June 2, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.99% the S&P500.
Matt Sirovich decreased its stake in Jd Com Inc (JD) by 6.18% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Scopia Capital Management Lp sold 308,964 shares as the company’s stock declined 24.45% with the market. The hedge fund run by Matt Sirovich held 4.69 million shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $189.95 million, down from 5.00M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Scopia Capital Management Lp who had been investing in Jd Com Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $51.51B market cap company. The stock increased 2.59% or $0.91 $36.09. About 11.36 million shares traded. JD.com, Inc. (NASDAQ:JD) has declined 10.12% since June 2, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 22.69% the S&P500.
Scopia Capital Management Lp, which manages about $7.11 billion and $5.00 billion US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Zogenix Inc by 51,039 shares to 3.47 million shares, valued at $139.04 million in 2018Q1, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Johnson Ctls Intl Plc by 412,417 shares in the quarter, for a total of 8.34M shares, and has risen its stake in Forest City Rlty Tr Inc.
